CustomField.label: Pricing Review Answers
CustomField.description: Sales Tools > Pricing Review View Checklist Tool: JSON of the 24 checklist answers plus completion metadata (director, completed date). Written by PricingReviewController.createReview and read back on the tool page; presence marks the review complete.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Managed by the Pricing Review View Checklist Tool. Stores the completed 24-question pricing review responses as JSON; do not edit by hand.
